name: Here It Comes
look: A selfie of a man with short dark hair in a dark T-shirt screaming at the camera, eyes squinted and mouth wide open, while a tall brown dust devil spins across a flat red desert behind him under a blue sky.
use: The swirling dust storm is something big and unstoppable heading your way, and the screaming man is you as it arrives. Labels name the incoming disaster and the person panicking.
slots: label on the dust devil (what is coming)
label on the screaming man (who is about to get hit)
examples: Me, who hasn't opened the textbook
My credit card bill after the holidays
describe: guy screaming in a selfie with a tornado behind him
man yelling at the camera as a dust storm spins in the desert
dude taking a selfie in front of a whirlwind in the outback
screaming man with a dust devil coming right at him
terrified selfie with a twister over red dirt
